<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED (literal, a string literal in ERROR_CODE_LEDGER; a string literal in objectPackageDisabledError))_
- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`  _(via OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED (literal, a string literal in ERROR_CODE_LEDGER; a string literal in objectPackageDisabledError))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED (literal, a string literal in ERROR_CODE_LEDGER; a string literal in objectPackageDisabledError))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED (literal, a string literal in ERROR_CODE_LEDGER; a string literal in objectPackageDisabledError))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **251** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **184** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a731859def47e2c8cefcab4d635a1c45c60c2c1` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `34072ab61bd4a47ea951e0477fccf1d28592df0e` — the merge of head `1741fd745e55ab2f0833159787d506333071906e` into base `6a731859def47e2c8cefcab4d635a1c45c60c2c1`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 34072ab61bd4a47ea951e0477fccf1d28592df0e && git checkout 34072ab61bd4a47ea951e0477fccf1d28592df0e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6a731859def47e2c8cefcab4d635a1c45c60c2c1 1741fd745e55ab2f0833159787d506333071906e && git checkout -B drift-repro 6a731859def47e2c8cefcab4d635a1c45c60c2c1 && git merge --no-ff 1741fd745e55ab2f0833159787d506333071906e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a731859def47e2c8cefcab4d635a1c45c60c2c1
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6a731859def47e2c8cefcab4d635a1c45c60c2c1` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ab42e688b11e760bbc82e423748f2457f6716c31`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts + packages/core/src/utils/object-package-disabled.ts, packages/core/src/security/change-record-owner.ts, packages/core/src/index.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-refusals.ts

Inputs read: card #36261 (body and all three comments: triage, claim, os-dev-report), PR #36674 (body, eight-file list, net diff against `main` at this head), and the head's check-runs as they stood at 2026-11-23 11:03 UTC. The two test files and the changeset prose are the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; the changeset's declaration lines are judged in ②.

Check-runs at the moment of reading: 17 completed `success` (among them Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Spec property liveness, Type Check · source gates, Dogfood Regression Gate), 10 completed `skipped` (opt-in or schedule jobs, Queue verdict, Build Docs), and 19 still `in_progress` with no conclusion: Build Core, Build UI Deps, Test Core 1/10 to 10/10, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Live E2E UI. None had failed. The pending runs are not gate verdicts yet; this record cites none of them as green.

### ① Derived judgments

- Registered-code union: UNCHANGED, and that is right. `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` was already listed under `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/service-analytics`; `RegisteredErrorCode` is the deduped union over every owner key and `REGISTERED_ERROR_CODES` is built through a `Set`, so a third row under `@objectstack/core` adds no member to `ErrorCode`, to `ApiErrorSchema.code`, or to the generated `content/docs/references/api/error-code-ledger.mdx` (which prints the flat union and already lists the code). The author's "provenance row only" reading of the ledger hunk holds against the tree.
- The row is owed, and a row is the right shape, not a waiver. The one literal stamp site (`disabled.code = 'OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED'`) now sits in `packages/core/src/utils/object-package-disabled.ts`; `check:error-code-provenance` attributes a site to the package that defines it, so core's owner key must list the code or carry a waiver. A `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` entry (core stamping, metadata-protocol registered) would be the wrong shape here: core is itself a wire emitter through the Change Owner doors, the same position `CHANGE_OWNER_DISABLED` holds one line above, and a row plus a waiver is refused as dead weight. No waiver was added and none is needed.
- The remaining `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` row stays correct. That package still emits the code in production (`assertObjectRegistered`, `getMetaItem`, `getMetaItemLayered`, and the nested-relation refusal in `protocol-query-validation.ts`), now through the constructor it imports from core, and the ledger's rule is one row per emitting package. What changed is only that the gate no longer holds that row mechanically: it scans literals, the literal left the package, and the gate has no "row without a stamp site" direction outside the waiver table. That is the gate's declared blindness (an imported constructor is not seen as a second emitter), not a defect of this diff. The `@objectstack/service-analytics` row's comment ("metadata-protocol keeps its row for the data door") is still true.
- Public surface of `@objectstack/core`: WIDENED by one root export, `objectPackageDisabledError` (`export *` from `utils/object-package-disabled.js`). `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s export of the same name is unchanged in name and signature (a re-export of the one function, still re-exported from its root through `protocol.ts`), so its importers, `@objectstack/runtime` among them, are untouched.
- Accept set of the two Change Owner doors: NARROWED. `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/change-owner` and `POST /api/v1/data/:object/change-owner` answered `200` and moved the owner for an object of a disabled package; they now answer `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. The narrowing itself is right: it is the card's Done-when and the data door's own answer. Its declaration is not; see ②.
- `ChangeOwnerEngine` gains the optional `registry` member picked from `UserWorkEngine` (`readonly registry?: { isObjectPackageDisabled?(name: string): boolean }`). Optional, so no existing implementer breaks; the REST doors pass the ObjectQL engine, whose `registry` getter is the `SchemaRegistry` the data plane's `assertObjectRegistered` asks. Right.

### ② Semver level

- Level: `patch` on `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec` with `Metadata-protocol: none` is the correct level. Nothing a metadata author can write changes, and under ruling A a `none` kind ships `patch` whatever the widening or narrowing. All three packages are moved by the diff. Check Changeset is `success` on this head.
- Clause-②: the PR body and the changeset both declare a bare `Clause-②: no`. That line does not match what the diff publishes.
- M1 (must-fix) — the declaration omits the narrowing. The diff takes a `200` away from a public HTTP door and replaces it with `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; that is a published accept set narrowed, and every sibling of this exact class on `main` declares it so: `.changeset/35195-search-disabled-package.md` (`yes (narrowing: ...)`), `.changeset/35427-expand-disabled-package.md` (`no (narrowing: ...)`), `.changeset/35525-analytics-disabled-package.md` (`yes (narrowing)`, "the analytics doors newly answer `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` ... which they answered `200` with data before"), `.changeset/35526-calldata-relation-disabled-package.md` (`no (narrowing: ...)`). Each of those also carries the `!` in its title, a **BREAKING** banner with the FROM and TO, and an `adr-0087` disposition marker in the changeset body; this PR carries none of the four. The arm is not decoration: it is the one spelling the ADR-0087 registration gate, the queue guard and the dogfood battery read, and the dev report's own line "dogfood_battery: n/a — no `!` in the PR title and no (narrowing) arm" shows the battery was skipped because of the missing declaration. Fix, on the prose faces only: the `(narrowing)` arm on the `Clause-②:` line in both the PR body and the changeset, the `!` in the PR title and changeset headline, the BREAKING banner with FROM `200, owner changed and notification sent` and TO `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED, nothing written or sent; re-enable the package`, and the `adr-0087` marker (the siblings used `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`). The value beside the arm should be `yes`: the diff also adds a root export to `@objectstack/core`, and #35525 declared `yes` for an added optional key on an exported type. The code needs no change for M1.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the os-dev-report; nothing to answer.
- Deviation, file surface widened beyond the claim (`packages/core/src/utils/object-package-disabled.ts`, `packages/core/src/index.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-refusals.ts`, the ledger row, the changeset): ANSWERED, accepted. The move is forced on this tree. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` lists `@objectstack/core` as a workspace dependency and core does not list metadata-protocol, so core importing the constructor from its old home would close a package cycle; and core is in the admitted set of the lean `@objectstack/objectql/core` entry, whose closure ADR-0076 D2 keeps free of metadata-protocol (`core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts`, `check-lean-entry-closure.mjs`). The alternative, a second copy in core, is what the constructor's docblock forbids. The ledger row then follows mechanically from the stamp site's new package. `objectNotFoundError` and `recordNotFoundError` are the same move for the same reason.
- `l2_routing` ("contract-tier glance suggested but not required"): ANSWERED, not accepted as stated. A diff touching `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` owes the full review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by the schema face; this record is it.
- Out-of-scope note, `packages/services/service-analytics/src/api-exposure-door.ts:202` keeps a hand copy of the constructor: confirmed present on this head with the same code, status and sentence. Not in this diff; a follow-up card is the right carrier, since core now exports the one constructor and that package's own row would then want re-reading against the gate.
- Out-of-scope note, `recycle-bin-routes.ts` and the disabled-package switch: not verified here either; stays with topic #36229.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): no finding. The check is one in-memory registry predicate call before any read; the diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` — holds. The row sits under the owner key of the package that now stamps the literal, beside the sibling refusal of the same two doors. Its comment was read sentence by sentence against the tree: "404 from the same two Change Owner doors, the same wire path" (the routes' `sendRefusal` classifies a non-`UserWorkTransferRefusal` throw as the `/data` door does and answers the nested envelope; `change-owner-routes.ts` is unchanged); "refused before its switch is read" (true, line order in `offeredDefinition`); "stamped by `objectPackageDisabledError` (`utils/object-package-disabled.ts`)" (true); "metadata-protocol re-exports it and keeps its row for the data door" (true, line 767 of the file on this head). First consumer: `check:error-code-provenance`, which reads exactly this pair. Tried to break it: a duplicate inside one owner key (none, the three occurrences are under three keys), a shadowed or synonym spelling (the code is unchanged), a stale waiver (no waiver names this pair), a widened union (none, see ①).

`packages/core/src/utils/object-package-disabled.ts` — agrees. The body is the removed metadata-protocol body byte for byte: same sentence, `code`, `status: 404`, `object`. The docblock's list of raisers matches the call sites on this head.

`packages/core/src/security/change-record-owner.ts` — agrees with the card. `offeredDefinition` is the one function both `changeRecordOwner` and `changeRecordsOwner` call before `assertTarget`, any `engine.update` and any `emit`; the new line sits after the `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` check and before `changeOwnerOffReason`, so the package refusal precedes the switch. The predicate is called as a member call, so `this` is the registry. A registry that cannot answer hides nothing, which is the data plane's own convention (`isObjectOfDisabledPackage`: "a host whose registry cannot answer must not have every read refused"), not a fail-open invented here. In the bulk form the three `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` list checks still run first; the updated docblock states that order and the card asks only for "before the switch is read and before any write or notification".

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-refusals.ts` — agrees. The function is replaced by `export { objectPackageDisabledError } from '@objectstack/core'`; nothing else in that file uses the name locally, and the package's other modules import it from this module as before.

`packages/core/src/index.ts` — agrees; one `export *` of a one-symbol module, with a comment that names the three raisers correctly.

Findings:

- M1 (must-fix) — in ② above: the narrowing is undeclared (`Clause-②:` arm, `!`, BREAKING banner, `adr-0087` marker), against four same-class precedents on `main`.
- Nit — `object-package-disabled.ts` says "ADR-0076 D2's boundary keeps this package from importing `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`". True in effect (core is in the lean entry's admitted set), and it copies `object-not-found.ts`; the more direct force, the `metadata-protocol` to `core` package edge, goes unsaid. Accepted deviation; no head move asked.
- Nit — the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` row's own comment (line 767) does not say its stamp site now lives in core, so a later reader running the gate's `--report` finds no site under that package. The new core row's comment does record it. Accepted deviation or a follow-up with the service-analytics copy.
- Observation for the lane seat, not graded (prose face, outside this review): `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` documents both Change Owner doors with their `403 CHANGE_OWNER_DISABLED` and does not yet mention the new `404`.

Delta owed: M1's fix touches the changeset and the PR body and title. The changeset edit moves the head, and the `(narrowing)` arm adds the narrowing face, whose floor is every non-prose path of the diff; the five implementing files above were already read in full for this record.

Reviewed-by: `session_011y7As6YDLR8TJVDpdXzJyV`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## 维护者速读

- 结论：退回修改（REWORK）。代码本身没问题，问题在声明：这次改动让“更改负责人”对停用包的对象从成功变成拒绝，属于收窄，但 PR 和 changeset 没有按收窄来声明。
- 要改的只是文字面：changeset 与 PR 正文补收窄声明、标题加 `!`、补 BREAKING 说明和 adr-0087 标记，再跑 dogfood 全量。
- 无需你做任何事；修完由本审核线程读 delta。

## 席位核对

Verdict: **REWORK** · head `ab42e688b11e760bbc82e423748f2457f6716c31` · card #36261 · L2 record: comment 7099069577 (FAIL, M1)

Reviewed against GitHub at this head (diff, card body, `l1-face.mjs --pr 36674`, `pr-state.mjs`), not against the report.

### Checklist
- Shape: open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36261`; no closing keyword binds another card. `Fixes` is right: every Done-when line of the card is delivered (shared core check before the switch, single + bulk pins with no update/emit, enabled control, ablation 3 red then restored).
- Release path: no `content/docs/releases/` file.
- Changeset: `l1-face` flags `@objectstack/rest` touched with no entry. Not a defect: the only rest file is `change-owner-routes.test.ts`, rest ships `files: [dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md]` and its build tsconfig excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so nothing rest publishes moves.
- Changeset sentences read against the diff: the two door paths match `change-owner-routes.ts` (`/:object/change-owner`, `/:object/:id/change-owner` under the data prefix); "before the object's Change Owner switch is read" and "before any user lookup, write or notification" hold (`offeredDefinition` runs before `assertTarget` and `engine.update` in both functions); "re-exports the same function under the same name" holds. The level `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- Widened file surface (deviation): accepted. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` depends on `@objectstack/core`, so core importing the constructor back would be a package cycle; a second copy is forbidden by the constructor's docblock; the moved body is byte-identical; the ledger row follows from `check:error-code-provenance` attributing the stamp to core. The ledger row is provenance only: the registered-code union is deduped and `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` was already registered, so the union does not widen (L2 ① agrees).
- Benefit past the boundary: the REST doors resolve the ObjectQL engine, whose `registry` getter returns the `SchemaRegistry` that implements `isObjectPackageDisabled` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`); the optional chain matches the in-package precedent `servedObjects` in `user-assigned-work.ts`. Not run end to end; read only.
- Refusal assertions: core pins assert `code` + `status` + `object`; REST pins assert HTTP `404` and `error.code`.
- Gates at this head: 23 success, 11 expected skip, 0 failed, 32 pending when read. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check not yet concluded, so the gate face is NOT MEASURED here; it is re-read on the fixed head.

### REWORK items
1. **M1 (from the L2 record, confirmed here):** the narrowing is undeclared. Both Change Owner doors go from `200` (owner moved, notification sent) to `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. All four same-class siblings on `main` (`.changeset/35195-…`, `35427-…`, `35525-…`, `35526-…`) declare a `(narrowing)` arm, a `!` title, a **BREAKING** banner with FROM/TO and an `adr-0087` disposition marker. Fix in the changeset body and PR body: the `Clause-②:` line with the `(narrowing)` arm (the L2 recommends `yes (narrowing)` because the diff also adds a root export to `@objectstack/core`, precedent `35525`; take the value the ADR-0087 gate accepts), `!` in the PR title and changeset headline, the BREAKING banner (FROM `200, owner changed and notification sent` → TO `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED, nothing written or sent; re-enable the package`), and the `adr-0087` marker.
2. **Dogfood battery owed:** with the `(narrowing)` arm the battery is owed at the new head, in full, reds fixed or reported (`dogfood_battery` in the report, pinned to the head).
3. **Same round, prose face (recommended):** `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` documents both Change Owner doors' `403 CHANGE_OWNER_DISABLED` but not the new `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; add it there.

No code change is asked. Nits from the L2 (docblock credits ADR-0076 D2 without the package edge; the metadata-protocol ledger row comment does not note the stamp moved) are accepted deviations.

### Out of scope, disposition
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/api-exposure-door.ts:202` hand copy of the constructor: same text today, no user-visible cost, so not a card under the filing gate; left for whichever PR next touches that file.
- `recycle-bin-routes.ts` and the disabled-package switch: unverified; belongs to topic #36229 as a pointer comment for the seat, reach to be measured before any card.
